digest.component_or_area: binding store GET-rotation sidecar persistence and rollout
propositions: Introduce a dedicated rotation module that loads and persists GET-rotation sidecar state to .bridge_state/get_rotation.json while dual-writing legacy inline fields during rollout.
Implement max(sidecar_value, legacy_inline_value) chronological read for each Jira key to support interleaved old and new binary passes without loss of rotation progress.
Wire BindingStore and outbound_differ to shared rotation accessors and extract outbound wrappers to keep outbound_differ.py at or below 800 lines.
Stage and commit both rotation files (sidecar and legacy inline) through the explicit BindingStore.save() path without git add -A.
Preserve rollback capability: reverted readers ignore the sidecar but see the legacy field advanced by every new-binary pass.
